header: Set up email notifications for report updates
content:
７ Note
The name and description fields for a new notification rule only accept English
letters and numbers. Punctuations like spaces, dashes, underscores, aren't
supported.
5. Add at least one recipient to receive the notification emails. You can also use this
screen to send a test email to check the notification settings.
6. Review your new rule. Select Edit at the end of each subsection to change any of
the settings. Once your review is complete, select Create rule.
7. Select Done to complete the process and close the flyout.

hierarchy.parent: Get email notifications for Threat analytics updates
